why: Softening C7 made the instruction ambiguous in short‑latency contexts: the model moved some cuts earlier (splitting prepositional phrases, pulling apart verb–object/adjunct sequences and producing one‑word fragments) which reduced H_set for small bins, while giving a tiny net gain on long pieces where the softer rule allowed useful additional cuts.
lesson: When softening predicate–argument constraints, make it explicit that the model must not shift cuts earlier in very short‑latency pieces so as to create isolated single‑word fragments or split tight verb‑argument/PP units.
